# Aurora Studio

> Aurora Studio is an independent game development studio based in Hong Kong, founded by Shiko Leung. The studio creates simulation and narrative experiences inspired by the places, stories, and cultures of East Asia.

Official website: https://www.aurora-studio.org/
Contact: https://www.aurora-studio.org/contact/

## Studio

- About Aurora Studio: https://www.aurora-studio.org/about/
- Projects: https://www.aurora-studio.org/project/
- Studio news: https://www.aurora-studio.org/news/
- Services: https://www.aurora-studio.org/services/
- ACG partnerships: https://www.aurora-studio.org/acg-partnerships/
  Cross-border ACG campaign strategy, rights-holder outreach support, localization and local activation for Hong Kong, the Greater Bay Area and Japan. Third-party IP participation requires approval.
- Governance: https://www.aurora-studio.org/governance/
- Support: https://www.aurora-studio.org/support/

## Projects

- Project Numazu: https://www.aurora-studio.org/project/project-numazu/
  OMSI 2 simulation add-on recreating Numazu, Shizuoka. Released in March 2026.
- Revenant of Tsushima: https://www.aurora-studio.org/project/revenant-of-tsushima/
  First-person Japanese folk horror game set around an Edo-period journey. In development.
  Official project site: https://revenant-tsushima.aurora-studio.org/
- Railway Depot: Operations & Empire: https://www.aurora-studio.org/project/railway-depot/
  Railway depot operations and management simulation. Pre-alpha.
- Aurora Engine: https://www.aurora-studio.org/project/aurora-engine/
  Modular C++ and Unreal Engine framework for NPC perception, memory, decisions, and actions.
